local View = {}

local function fontFace(weight)
	return Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/Montserrat.json", Enum.FontWeight[weight], Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
end

	bgTop = Color3.fromRGB(9, 20, 35),
	bgBottom = Color3.fromRGB(4, 10, 22),
	bloomA = Color3.fromRGB(36, 120, 190),
	bloomB = Color3.fromRGB(20, 71, 140),
	bloomC = Color3.fromRGB(11, 41, 88),
	textPrimary = Color3.fromRGB(244, 251, 255),
	textSecondary = Color3.fromRGB(184, 212, 232),
	textMuted = Color3.fromRGB(159, 188, 214),
	shadow = Color3.fromRGB(6, 16, 28),
	dim = Color3.fromRGB(3, 8, 18),

	gold = Color3.fromRGB(231, 185, 90),
}

local function addTextShadow(parent, sourceLabel, offset, transparency)
	local shadow = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	shadow.Name = "Shadow"
	shadow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	shadow.BorderSizePixel = 0
	shadow.AnchorPoint = sourceLabel.AnchorPoint
	shadow.Position = sourceLabel.Position + (offset or UDim2.fromOffset(0, 2))
	shadow.Size = sourceLabel.Size
	shadow.ZIndex = math.max(1, sourceLabel.ZIndex - 1)
	shadow.Text = sourceLabel.Text
	shadow.TextColor3 = PALETTE.shadow
	shadow.TextTransparency = transparency or 0.45
	shadow.TextScaled = sourceLabel.TextScaled
	shadow.TextSize = sourceLabel.TextSize
	shadow.FontFace = sourceLabel.FontFace
	shadow.TextWrapped = sourceLabel.TextWrapped
	shadow.TextXAlignment = sourceLabel.TextXAlignment
	shadow.TextYAlignment = sourceLabel.TextYAlignment
	shadow.RichText = sourceLabel.RichText
	shadow.Parent = parent
	return shadow
end

local function attachNativeShadow(parent, name, size, position, z)
	local host = Instance.new("Frame")
	host.Name = name
	host.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	host.BorderSizePixel = 0
	host.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	host.Size = size
	host.Position = position
	host.ZIndex = z
	local ok, uiShadow = pcall(Instance.new, "UIShadow")
	if ok and uiShadow then
		uiShadow.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		uiShadow.Transparency = 0.72
		uiShadow.BlurRadius = UDim.new(0, 18)
		uiShadow.Offset = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 7)
		uiShadow.Parent = host
	else
		local fallback = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
		fallback.Name = "FallbackShadow"
		fallback.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		fallback.BorderSizePixel = 0
		fallback.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		fallback.ImageTransparency = 1
		fallback.Parent = host
	end
	host.Parent = parent
	return host
end

local function createTextLabel(name, text, size, textSize, weight, z)
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = name
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.BorderSizePixel = 0
	label.Size = size
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = PALETTE.textPrimary
	label.TextSize = textSize
	label.FontFace = fontFace(weight)
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.TextScaled = false
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	label.ZIndex = z
	return label
end

local function trackConnection(connection)
	table.insert(cleaners, function()
		if connection.Connected then
			connection:Disconnect()
		end
	end)
	return connection
end

local function stopTween(key)
	local tween = activeTweens[key]
	if tween then
		tween:Cancel()
		activeTweens[key] = nil
	end
end

local function playTween(key, object, info, goal)
	stopTween(key)
	local tween = TweenService:Create(object, info, goal)
	activeTweens[key] = tween
	tween:Play()
	trackConnection(tween.Completed:Connect(function()
		if activeTweens[key] == tween then
			activeTweens[key] = nil
		end
	end))
	return tween
end

local function iterNamed(name)
	local results = {}
	for _, descendant in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant.Name == name then
			table.insert(results, descendant)
		end
	end
	return results
end

local function getSiblingShadow(control)
	if not control or not control.Parent then
		return nil
	end
	local exact = control.Parent:FindFirstChild(control.Name .. "Shadow")
	if exact and exact:IsA("GuiObject") then
		return exact
	end
	return nil
end

local function bindButtonEffects(button)
	local visual = button:FindFirstChild("Visual") or button
	local shadow = getSiblingShadow(button)
	local ok, controller = pcall(function()
		return ButtonEffects.bind(button, {
			visual = visual,
			shadow = shadow,
			sounds = false,
			hoverEnabled = true,
			hoverScale = button.Name == "PlayButton" and 1.03 or 1.025,
			pressScale = button.Name == "PlayButton" and 0.97 or 0.975,
			duration = 0.14,
			animations = true,
		})
	end)
	if ok and controller then
		table.insert(cleaners, function()
			controller:Destroy()
		end)
	end
end

for _, name in ipairs({
	"PlayButton",
	"SettingsButton",
	"CreditsButton",
	"SettingsCloseButton",

}) do

local function applyToggleVisual(toggle)
	local visual = toggle:FindFirstChild("Visual")
	if not visual then
		return
	end
	local onState = visual:FindFirstChild("MusicToggleOn")
	local offState = visual:FindFirstChild("MusicToggleOff")
	local thumb = visual:FindFirstChild("MusicToggleThumb")
	if not (onState and offState and thumb) then
		return
	end

	local targetPos = menuState.musicOn and UDim2.new(0.76, 0, 0.5, 0) or UDim2.new(0.24, 0, 0.5, 0)
	local targetOff = menuState.musicOn and 1 or 0
	local targetOn = menuState.musicOn and 0 or 1

	if GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled then
		thumb.Position = targetPos
		offState.ImageTransparency = targetOff
		onState.ImageTransparency = targetOn
		return
	end

	playTween(toggle:GetDebugId() .. "_thumb", thumb, TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = targetPos,
	})
	playTween(toggle:GetDebugId() .. "_off", offState, TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		ImageTransparency = targetOff,
	})
	playTween(toggle:GetDebugId() .. "_on", onState, TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		ImageTransparency = targetOn,
	})
end

local function updateAllToggleVisuals()
	for _, toggle in ipairs(iterNamed("MusicToggle")) do
		if toggle:IsA("GuiButton") then
			applyToggleVisual(toggle)
		end
	end
end

local function setSliderVisual(slider)
	local fillClip = slider:FindFirstChild("TrackFillClip")
	local handle = slider:FindFirstChild("VolumeSliderHandle")
	local handleShadow = slider:FindFirstChild("VolumeSliderHandleShadow")
	local clamped = math.clamp(menuState.volume, 0, 1)

	if fillClip then
		fillClip.Size = UDim2.new(clamped, 0, 0, 20)
	end
	if handle then
		handle.Position = UDim2.new(clamped, 0, 0.5, 0)
	end
	if handleShadow and handleShadow:IsA("GuiObject") then
		handleShadow.Position = UDim2.new(clamped, 0, 0.5, 0)
	end

	local row = slider.Parent
	if row then
		local value = row:FindFirstChild("VolumeValue")
		if value and value:IsA("TextLabel") then
			value.Text = tostring(math.floor(clamped * 100 + 0.5)) .. "%"
			local shadow = row:FindFirstChild("Shadow")
			if shadow and shadow:IsA("TextLabel") and shadow.Position == value.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 2) then
				shadow.Text = value.Text
			end
		end
	end
end

local function updateAllSliderVisuals()
	for _, slider in ipairs(iterNamed("VolumeSlider")) do
		if slider:IsA("Frame") then
			setSliderVisual(slider)
		end
	end
end

					GroupTransparency = 0,
				})
			else
				playTween(dock:GetDebugId() .. "_menuOut", dock, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
					GroupTransparency = 1,
				})
			end
		end

local function setPanelContentTransparency(content, opening)
	for _, child in ipairs(content:GetDescendants()) do
		if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
			if opening then
				local target = child.Name == "CreditsBody" and 0 or 0
				playTween(child:GetDebugId() .. "_text", child, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
					TextTransparency = target,
				})
			else
				playTween(child:GetDebugId() .. "_text", child, TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
					TextTransparency = 1,
				})
			end
		elseif child:IsA("ImageLabel") or child:IsA("ImageButton") then
			if opening then
				local target = 0
				if child.Name == "MusicToggleOff" then
					target = menuState.musicOn and 1 or 0
				elseif child.Name == "MusicToggleOn" then
					target = menuState.musicOn and 0 or 1
				end
				playTween(child:GetDebugId() .. "_img", child, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
					ImageTransparency = target,
				})
			else
				playTween(child:GetDebugId() .. "_img", child, TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
					ImageTransparency = 1,
				})
			end
		end
	end
end

local function animatePanel(host, opening)
	if not host then
		return
	end

	local overlay = host:FindFirstChild("Overlay")
	local panel = host:FindFirstChild("SettingsModal") or host:FindFirstChild("CreditsModal")
	if not overlay or not panel then
		host.Visible = opening
		return
	end

	local content = panel:FindFirstChild("Content")
	local shadow = host:FindFirstChild(host.Name == "SettingsModalHost" and "SettingsModalShadow" or "CreditsModalShadow")
	local overlayShownTransparency = host.Name == "CreditsModalHost" and 0.44 or 0.38

	if opening then
		host.Visible = true
		overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		panel.ImageTransparency = 1
		panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 12)
		if shadow and shadow:IsA("GuiObject") then
			shadow.Visible = true
			shadow.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 16)
		end
		if content then
			for _, child in ipairs(content:GetDescendants()) do
				if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
					child.TextTransparency = 1
				elseif child:IsA("ImageLabel") or child:IsA("ImageButton") then
					child.ImageTransparency = 1
				end
			end
		end

		playTween(host:GetDebugId() .. "_overlayOpen", overlay, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			BackgroundTransparency = overlayShownTransparency,
		})
		playTween(host:GetDebugId() .. "_panelOpen", panel, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			ImageTransparency = 0,
			Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
		})
		if shadow and shadow:IsA("GuiObject") and not GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled then
			playTween(host:GetDebugId() .. "_shadowOpen", shadow, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 4),
			})
		end
		if content then
			setPanelContentTransparency(content, true)
		end
	else
		playTween(host:GetDebugId() .. "_overlayClose", overlay, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		})
		local closeTween = playTween(host:GetDebugId() .. "_panelClose", panel, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
			ImageTransparency = 1,
			Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 10),
		})
		if shadow and shadow:IsA("GuiObject") and not GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled then
			playTween(host:GetDebugId() .. "_shadowClose", shadow, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
				Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 14),
			})
		end
		if content then
			setPanelContentTransparency(content, false)
		end
		trackConnection(closeTween.Completed:Connect(function()
			if host.Parent then
				host.Visible = false
			end
		end))
	end
end

local function closeCurrentPanel()
	if not currentPanel then
		return
	end
	local panels = getPanels()
	local panelSet = panels[currentPanel]
	if panelSet then
		animatePanel(panelSet.host, false)
		animatePanel(panelSet.peer, false)
	end
	currentPanel = nil
	setMenuVisible(true)
end

local function openPanel(name)
	local panels = getPanels()
	if currentPanel and currentPanel ~= name then
		closeCurrentPanel()
	end
	currentPanel = name
	setMenuVisible(false)
	local panelSet = panels[name]
	if panelSet then
		animatePanel(panelSet.host, true)
		animatePanel(panelSet.peer, true)
	end
end

local function sliderValueFromInput(slider, inputPositionX)
	local absoluteX = slider.AbsolutePosition.X
	local absoluteWidth = slider.AbsoluteSize.X
	if absoluteWidth <= 0 then
		return menuState.volume
	end
	return math.clamp((inputPositionX - absoluteX) / absoluteWidth, 0, 1)
end

local function beginSliderDrag(slider, inputPositionX)
	draggingSlider = slider
	menuState.volume = sliderValueFromInput(slider, inputPositionX)
	updateAllSliderVisuals()
end

for _, slider in ipairs(iterNamed("VolumeSlider")) do
	if slider:IsA("Frame") then
		local hitArea = slider:FindFirstChild("HitArea")
		if hitArea and hitArea:IsA("GuiButton") then
			trackConnection(hitArea.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
					beginSliderDrag(slider, input.Position.X)
				end
			end))
			trackConnection(hitArea.Activated:Connect(function()
				local position = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
				menuState.volume = sliderValueFromInput(slider, position.X)
				updateAllSliderVisuals()
			end))
		end
	end
end

trackConnection(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if not draggingSlider then
		return
	end
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		menuState.volume = sliderValueFromInput(draggingSlider, input.Position.X)
		updateAllSliderVisuals()
	end
end))

trackConnection(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		draggingSlider = nil
	end
end))

for _, button in ipairs(iterNamed("PlayButton")) do
	if button:IsA("GuiButton") then
		trackConnection(button.Activated:Connect(function()
			if menuState.menuClosed then
				return
			end
			menuState.menuClosed = true
			closeCurrentPanel()

			for _, host in ipairs(iterNamed("SettingsModalHost")) do
				if host:IsA("GuiObject") then
					host.Visible = false
				end
			end
			for _, host in ipairs(iterNamed("CreditsModalHost")) do
				if host:IsA("GuiObject") then
					host.Visible = false
				end
			end

			local screenFade = playTween("screen_close", root, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
				Enabled = false,
			})
			if not screenFade then
				root.Enabled = false
			end
			root.Enabled = false

			for _, hook in ipairs(iterNamed("OnPlayRequestedHook")) do
				if hook:IsA("BindableEvent") then
					hook:Fire()
				end
			end
		end))
	end
end

updateAllToggleVisuals()
updateAllSliderVisuals()

trackConnection(root.Destroying:Connect(function()
	for _, cleanup in ipairs(cleaners) do
		cleanup()
	end
	table.clear(cleaners)
	for key in pairs(activeTweens) do
		stopTween(key)
	end
end))

local Responsive = {}
function Responsive.bind(root)
    local cameraConnection
    local connections = {}
    local function update()
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return end
        local size = camera.ViewportSize
        local mobile = math.min(size.X, size.Y) < 600
        for _, node in root:GetDescendants() do
            if node:IsA("GuiObject") then
                if node.Name == "_NexusDesktop" then node.Visible = not mobile end
                if node.Name == "_NexusMobile" then node.Visible = mobile end
            end
        end
    end
    local function observeCamera()
        if cameraConnection then cameraConnection:Disconnect() end
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if camera then cameraConnection = camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(update) end
        update()
    end
    table.insert(connections, workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(observeCamera))
    local function cleanup()
        if cameraConnection then cameraConnection:Disconnect() end
        for _, connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(connections)
    end
    table.insert(connections, root.Destroying:Connect(cleanup))
    observeCamera()
    return cleanup
end
return Responsive

-- Original reference implementation from 06-ui-motion-and-interaction.md
-- Reviewed 2026-09-11. Not Roblox Studio runtime-verified.

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ButtonFeedback = {}
local bound = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local lastSoundAt = { hover = -math.huge, click = -math.huge }

-- Backward compatible: bind(button, childVisual) or bind(button, options).
-- Prefer options.visual = the stable button's child Visual frame.
function ButtonFeedback.bind(button, visualOrOptions, options)
    local visual
    if typeof(visualOrOptions) == "Instance" then
        visual = visualOrOptions
        options = options or {}
    else
        options = visualOrOptions or {}
        visual = options.visual or button:FindFirstChild("Visual") or button
    end
    assert(button:IsA("GuiButton"), "expected a GuiButton")
    assert(visual:IsA("GuiObject") and (visual == button or visual:IsDescendantOf(button)),
        "visual must be a child visual inside the button")
    assert(not bound[button], "button already has a feedback binding")
    assert(not visual:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale"),
        "visual UIScale already has an owner")
    local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
    scale.Name = "FeedbackScale"
    scale.Parent = visual
    local alive, focused = true, GuiService.SelectedObject == button
    local currentTween = nil
    local shadowTween = nil
    local connections = {}
    local sounds = {}
    local originalAutoColor = button.AutoButtonColor
    button.AutoButtonColor = false
    local controller = {}
    bound[button] = controller
    local previousState = nil
    local hoverScale = math.clamp(tonumber(options.hoverScale) or 1.05, 1, 1.1)
    local pressScale = math.clamp(tonumber(options.pressScale) or 0.95, 0.85, 1)
    local duration = math.clamp(tonumber(options.duration) or 0.12, 0.06, 0.3)
    local shadow = options.shadow
    local shadowPosition = shadow and shadow.Position

    local function soundFor(kind, soundId)
        if type(soundId) ~= "string" or not soundId:match("^rbxassetid://%d+$") then return end
        local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
        sound.Name = "Feedback_" .. kind
        sound.SoundId = soundId
        sound.Volume = math.clamp(tonumber(options.volume) or 0.18, 0, 0.35)
        sound.Parent = button
        sounds[kind] = sound
    end
    soundFor("hover", options.hoverSound)
    soundFor("click", options.clickSound)

    local function playSound(kind)
        if not alive or not button.Interactable or options.sounds == false then return end
        local sound = sounds[kind]
        local now = os.clock()
        local delay = kind == "hover" and 0.12 or 0.08
        if not sound or now - lastSoundAt[kind] < delay then return end
        lastSoundAt[kind] = now
        sound.TimePosition = 0
        sound:Play()
    end

    local function pointerAvailable()
        return UserInputService.MouseEnabled
            and UserInputService:GetLastInputType() ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    end

    local function refresh()
        if not alive then return end
        local state = button.GuiState
        local target = 1
        if button.Interactable then
            if state == Enum.GuiState.Press then
                target = pressScale
            elseif (state == Enum.GuiState.Hover and pointerAvailable() and options.hoverEnabled ~= false) or focused then
                target = hoverScale
            end
        end
        if state == Enum.GuiState.Hover and previousState ~= state and pointerAvailable() and options.hoverEnabled ~= false then
            playSound("hover")
        end
        previousState = state
        if currentTween then
            currentTween:Cancel()
            currentTween = nil
        end
        if shadowTween then shadowTween:Cancel() end
        if GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled or options.animations == false then
            scale.Scale = 1
            if shadow then shadow.Position = shadowPosition end
            return
        end
        currentTween = TweenService:Create(scale,
            TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            { Scale = target })
        currentTween:Play()
        if shadow then
            local offset = state == Enum.GuiState.Press and -2 or 0
            shadowTween = TweenService:Create(shadow, TweenInfo.new(duration),
                { Position = shadowPosition + UDim2.fromOffset(0, offset) })
            shadowTween:Play()
        end
    end

    connections[#connections + 1] = button
        :GetPropertyChangedSignal("GuiState"):Connect(refresh)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button
        :GetPropertyChangedSignal("Interactable"):Connect(refresh)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.SelectionGained:Connect(function()
        focused = true
        refresh()
    end)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.SelectionLost:Connect(function()
        focused = false
        refresh()
    end)
    connections[#connections + 1] = GuiService
        :GetPropertyChangedSignal("ReducedMotionEnabled"):Connect(refresh)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.Activated:Connect(function()
        playSound("click")
    end)

    function controller:Destroy()
        if not alive then return end
        alive = false
        if currentTween then currentTween:Cancel() end
        if shadowTween then shadowTween:Cancel() end
        for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
        for _, sound in pairs(sounds) do sound:Destroy() end
        bound[button] = nil
        scale:Destroy()
        pcall(function() button.AutoButtonColor = originalAutoColor end)
        if shadow then pcall(function() shadow.Position = shadowPosition end) end
    end
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.Destroying:Connect(function()
        controller:Destroy()
    end)
    refresh()
    return controller
end

return ButtonFeedback
